name: FineSplat
aliases: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats
definition: A feed-forward method that predicts a set of 3D Gaussians from N context views (with or without known poses) using a two-stage dual-grouping strategy to balance local detail preservation with global multi-view reasoning.
summary: FineSplat is a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that uses high-resolution patch tokens and serialized 3D spatial attention to preserve fine details while avoiding the cost of global multi-view attention.
